caption: The drawing depicts a clear, spherical glass vessel with a slightly reflective surface, positioned centrally on the page. The upper portion of the vessel has a metal or metallic-looking cap fastened with a brown, possibly cork-like ring, through which two metal rods and one glass tube protrude vertically. The vessel sits on a pedestal made up of several stacked, rectangular platforms of a light grayish color, resembling stone or metal. The entire object is rendered with shades of gray, white, and subtle hints of brown, with fine details indicating depth and shadow. The background is a plain, light beige color. There is a handwritten signature and the words "full size P. Ward" at the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
